text:
Cass (CSM): Quick flag — AtlasEdge onboarding produced an unexpected token surge overnight. QBR Thursday; need a concise cost slide + owner list. Internal notes: https://redwood.internal/atlasedge-onboard

Rohan (AM): saw the spike. Looks like parallel embedding jobs + a background batch job running per-file similarity checks. Pulling per-route heatmap and last 7d totals now.

quota-bot: ALERT: Account=AtlasEdge projected to exceed monthly commit by 34% in 5d. Top sources: embeddings 64%, similarity-batch 22%, assistant-gen 10%.

Maya (FinOps): Can someone paste a 7d token rollup SQL so I can model dollar exposure? Example: `SELECT product, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE account='atlasedge' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY product ORDER BY tokens DESC;` Need absolute numbers for the QBR calc.

Ethan (Solutions Eng): Quick hypotheses: 1) ingestion duplicates due to retries, 2) client batching set to very large windows, 3) no prefix dedupe on similarity route. I can run a fast staging experiment: enable prefix KV cache, reduce embedding_batch_limit to 128, and flip on 'token_windowing' to avoid resending prior context. ETA ~2.5h.

Cass (CSM): Great. For the QBR I need 3 customer-facing bullets: what we changed immediately, short-term recommendations, and next steps + presenters. Keep it non-technical.

Rohan (AM): Draft bullets for slide:
- Immediate: paused nightly similarity full-scan and throttled embedding ingestion to 550 TPS (owners: Rohan/Ethan).
- Short-term: enabled per-account prefix dedupe cache and set embedding batch limit to 128 to reduce duplicate tokens by ~30% (owner: Ethan).
- Policy: enabled budget webhook at 85% of commit and temporary hard cap at 125% to avoid bill shock; FinOps to review commit (owner: Maya).

I'll present the mitigation + numbers at QBR. :thumbsup:

Maya (FinOps): I like the 85% pre-alert + 125% soft cap. I'll produce an estimated $ impact table once Rohan posts token totals. Also recommending we offer an onboarding credit extension if they stay above commit due to legitimate growth — details in slide.

Ethan (Solutions Eng): Staging commands I'll run (sanitized):
```bash
# enable cache, reduce batch, set ingest limit
curl -X POST https://dedicated.redwood/v1/accounts/atlasedge/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"kv_cache":true,"embedding_batch_limit":128,"ingest_rate_limit":550,"token_windowing":true}'
```
I'll post token delta & 95p latency after a 90m test.

Cass (CSM): Perfect. Also capture a single QBR slide action: schedule 45-min enablement to review prompt shaping, dedupe patterns, and a lightweight client-side batching change (owner: Cass).

Rohan (AM): Pasted 7d totals: embeddings=4,200,000 tokens; similarity-batch=1,450,000 tokens; assistant-gen=650,000 tokens.

Maya (FinOps): Thanks. Quick calc: projected overage ~34% -> est $5.6k over commit this month if unchanged. With cache + batch changes we estimate ~28-34% reduction on the offending flows -> potential savings ~$1.8k-$2.1k. I'll add this sensitivity to the QBR slide.

quota-bot: NOTE: Created ticket #CS-20999 'AtlasEdge onboarding spend triage' (owner: Rohan).

Ethan (Solutions Eng): Follow-ups I'll add to the ticket: rollback criteria, monitoring playbook (tokens/day, 95p latency, error rates), and a 48h watch window. Will capture metrics on the ticket before QBR.

Cass (CSM): Thanks team. Rohan will present cost + mitigation, Maya will run through the $ sensitivity. I'll send the one-pager to the customer before the call. :white_check_mark:
